name: Enshrouded
notes: enshrouded_server.json is written on the first start. Stop the server before editing it: the server overwrites it on exit. Set gameSettingsPreset to Custom, or the preset wins over your gameSettings values. The server writes its log to logs\enshrouded_server.log rather than the console pipe, so Basecamp tails that file. Friends join with the host and the query port.
